name: Noga
title: Son of King David
summary: Noga was one of the sons of King David, born in Jerusalem. He is mentioned in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles as part of David's royal descendants. Although little is known about his individual life, he is part of the important Davidic lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Noga is listed among the sons of David who were born in Jerusalem, as part of the royal lineage.

keyEvents.title: Sons of David Born in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: After David established himself as king in Jerusalem, he had several sons, including Noga, who was part of the growing royal house.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Davidic Lineage
keyEvents.description: As a son of David, Noga is part of the messianic lineage that holds great theological significance throughout the Bible.

keyEvents.title: David's Kingdom in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Noga was born during the period when David ruled from Jerusalem over all Israel, a time of greatness and expansion for the kingdom of Israel.
